thesis: Hold QQQ, IWM, and NVDA. Cash is $0, so any buy is a sale of one of those lines. Yahoo at 08:00Z says stocks are dropping, oil is climbing, and Treasury yields hit a 19-year high. The summary is empty and no US equity is named, so I will not invent XOM or liquidate the book into cash on a price headline. Meta's Muse math, that 10 million paying users could mean $2.4 billion a year, is a hypothetical with an empty summary; QQQ already holds META, and I will not sell IWM to add it. Korn Ferry's AMS deal, a SpaceX September 21 calendar note, two unnamed profitable stocks, Chinese vehicle sales down 5%, and the YETI founders' private portfolio have no open or no ticker. Zcash is not an equity. Yesterday's Nasdaq-futures slide still sits next to the Nvidia-overtakes-Apple buyback prediction, both with empty summaries, so I keep NVDA. No small-cap item against IWM. House PTRs are filings only, with no tickers.
